base_policy.ckpt_sha256_note: place_container_plate lock is the live Base200 600.ckpt on disk (mtime 2026-08-10, brace_base200_provenance / Line A). The previously written 8fd41687 hash is the Aug-4 census file, which is no longer present; it must not be used for T1b.

t1b_frozen_difficulty.policy_seed_rule: policy_seed = 5000 + repeat (repeat in 0..7); offset 5000 chosen to be disjoint from legacy census offset 3000 and phase1 offset 0
t1b_frozen_difficulty.disjointness: The 240-seed pool never touches confirm_easy ({base}+500..599), confirm_hard ({base}+600..699), or expert_demo_supplement ({base}+700..899) of experiments/brace/seeds/multitask_v1/*.json. Those pools stay reserved for confirmation evaluation and D_Q respectively.
t1b_frozen_difficulty.outputs: runs/<utcstamp>_t1_difficulty_{task}/ ; JSON rows only, no hdf5, no chunk export
t1b_frozen_difficulty.missingness_rule: UnStableError episodes are recorded as operational missingness (evaluated=false) and excluded from the p0 denominator; the seed keeps its remaining repeats; seeds are never swapped.
t1b_frozen_difficulty.compute: 8x RTX 4090, 3 simulator shards per GPU = 24 shards per task; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES set per shard by the launcher; every shard runs with --resume

difficulty_grouping.model: Beta-Binomial posterior p0 | s ~ Beta(1 + s, 1 + R - s), R = 8

groups.unsupported_tail: s = 0 of 8 (subset of hard, flagged separately for the zero-support unidentifiability analysis)

difficulty_grouping.freeze_rule: difficulty_groups.v1.json + sha256 written once from the completed 240x8 run of pi0 ONLY; never re-derived from any post-treatment checkpoint (post-treatment grouping bias ban).
difficulty_grouping.min_evaluated_repeats_rule: A seed with fewer than 6 evaluated repeats (operational missingness) is excluded from grouping and listed explicitly in difficulty_groups.v1.json; it does not silently change any denominator.

t1c_data_sources.d_e_d_m_d_h: stratified 100 seeds sampled from the frozen 240 (proportional to group sizes, deterministic rule recorded at freeze time); pi0 run 8x per seed; store ONLY complete successful trajectories; no action-chunk export; frozen Base200 expert set (200 demos) is never modified.
t1c_data_sources.d_q: expert-script success-first collection on expert_demo_supplement seeds ({base}+700..899); escalating budget Q in {5, 10, 20} per zero-support seed

t1d_dose_design.design: 9-point D-optimal: 1 zero-dose optimizer-only point, 4 single-source vertices (D_E, D_M, D_H, D_Q), 3 two-source mixes, 1 double center point; +3 held-out mix points for prediction validation
t1d_dose_design.budget: 10-20% of a full fine-tune per point
t1d_dose_design.freeze_rule: dose points fixed only AFTER t1b grouping (they depend on the observed p0 distribution) and before any training run
t1d_dose_design.gpu_rule: DP fine-tuning exclusive, 1 process per GPU
t1d_dose_design.tomography_gate: Spearman(T_hat, held-out deltas) >= 0.6 with CI lower bound > 0; MAE <= 5pp; 90% PI empirical coverage in [80%, 100%]; quadratic term must not dominate linear within w <= 3

legacy_isolation: No artifact from experiments/brace/ or bak/ enters any T1 computation.
BRACE-RW E0 remains stopped; its archives are read-only.
census v142 (R=3) and the bak 100x8 sketch appear only in the comparison appendix.
